Sun and orientation

  • North is the street / neighbour corner. The street faces north-west, the neighbour's high wall north-east, the vacant plot south-west and the rear south-east.
  • The vacant-plot side (SW) gets the most sun, from midday to sunset, and it also has the sea view. That is the best side for a pool and loungers.
  • The strip along the high wall (NE) is the shadiest. The house already sits there, so the shadow it casts falls mostly on its own side. That suits parking, storage and service areas.
  • A pool (street garden): good afternoon and evening sun, but the house to its south-east shades it early in the day, and it is exposed to the street.
  • B pool (middle, SW side): sun from late morning to sunset, clear of the house shadow, and it faces the view.
